name: Reliance Industries

snapshot.about: Energy, petrochemicals, telecommunications, retail, FMCG, media, and new energy projects.

narrative: Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹330,601 crore (+29.8% YoY) and net profit rose to ₹29,550 crore (+33.8% YoY), accelerating from Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 25% and net profit growth of 6% as energy and retail performance strengthened.

promises.statement: Scaling vertically integrated solar PV module production capacity to 20 GW.

said.quote: We started with an announcement of 10 gigawatt-peak, which we are now scaling up to 20 gigawatt of solar PV module production completely vertically integrated

actual_source.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion

promises.statement: On track to complete 40 GWh battery energy storage gigafactory capacity at Jamnagar.

said.quote: So, we are currently on track to complete 40 gigawatt hours of battery energy storage gigafactory at Jamnagar

actual_source.quote: We will achieve 40-gigawatt hour capacity this year and we have announced the scale￾up through our AGM up to 120-gigawatt hour capacity

promises.statement: Targeting to complete PVC and PetChem expansion projects by end of calendar year 2026.

said.quote: As of now, our target is to complete them by next year, next year end, calendar year end. That is the target we are running with

promises.statement: New Energy segment is on track to achieve 20 GW annual integrated solar PV capacity.

said.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion

promises.statement: Battery manufacturing capacity will reach 40 GWh this year, with plans to scale to 120 GWh.

said.quote: We will achieve 40-gigawatt hour capacity this year and we have announced the scale￾up through our AGM up to 120-gigawatt hour capacity

promises.statement: GCP Data Center project capacity to evolve into over 100 MW over the next two years.

said.quote: Well, we have started with the first phase of the GCP project itself and that will evolve into little over 100 megawatt over the next two years

promises.statement: Retail business targets doubling absolute EBITDA over the next three years.

said.quote: What we are saying is we are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number

promises.statement: FMCG business targets reaching Rs. 1 lakh crore in revenue by FY30.

said.quote: we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030

promises.statement: Company is on track to commission its first fully integrated 10 GW peak solar gigafactory.

said.quote: We are well on our track to commission our first fully integrated 10-gigawatt peak annual solar manufacturing gigafactory and we have already announced that we are scaling this up to 20-gigawatt peak annual capacity

actual_source.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion

cash.read: Operating cash flow of ₹755,290 crore over FY22–FY26 comfortably covered cumulative reported net profit of ₹398,016 crore, demonstrating strong operational cash conversion.

bull.point: Cumulative operating cash flow of ₹755,290 crore over FY22–FY26 significantly exceeded total reported profit of ₹398,016 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹755,290 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹398,016 crore.

bull.point: Jio Platforms expanded its EBITDA margin to 53.3% in Q1 FY27, up from 52.0% reported in prior quarters.

evidence.quote: 36,000 Crores plus revenue, 45% of revenue market share in the connectivity business, 52% EBITDA margin for JPL
EBITDA at Rs.20,865 Crores, that is a 15.1% year-on-year growth, with an EBITDA margin of 53.3%

bull.point: Reliance Retail FMCG quarterly revenue doubled year-on-year to ₹8,600 crore in Q1 FY27, expanding rapidly from full-year FY26 revenue of ₹22,000 crore.

evidence.quote: From an FMCG business perspective, we closed our revenue of Rs.22,000 Crores in 2026
This quarter, we delivered Rs. 8,600 Crores revenue on FMCG. This was double the growth as compared to last year

bear.point: Legal proceedings include a $1.87 billion demand notice from the Government of India for alleged gas migration, currently pending before the Supreme Court.

evidence.quote: A demand letter dated 1st March 2025 for payment of $ 2.81 billion (RIL share $ 1.87 billion) was sent by GoI to the Contractor

bear.point: Ongoing disputes with the Government of India include cost disallowances under the Production Sharing Contract for Block KG-DWN-98/3.

evidence.quote: Disallowance of certain costs under the Production Sharing Contract (PSC), relating to Block KG‑DWN-98/3 and consequent deposit of differential revenue on gas sales from D1D3 field

bear.point: Reliance on complex IT systems for processing high transaction volumes across revenue and raw materials was designated a key audit matter.

evidence.quote: We identified IT systems and controls over financial reporting as a key audit matter for the Company because its financial accounting and reporting systems are fundamentally reliant on IT systems
